title: Run final SRD importer source-completeness audit
description:
Problem

After the holistic importer changes, the project needs a final source-vs-output audit pass to verify that the SRD importer is actually complete against the PDF and not merely passing existing tests.

Task

Regenerate the SRD audit bundle and perform the same three audit checks:

1. For each record the importer created, verify it against the source PDF for accuracy and completeness.
2. For each record type, verify there is nothing in the source PDF that should have resulted in a record but did not.
3. Search the PDF for content that should have a record type or structured child representation but does not.

This bead should be done after the source inventory, bounded spans, table extraction, stat-block extraction, and semantic modeling beads have landed.

Audit focus areas

- subclass records do not swallow feature text,
- magic-item records do not swallow following magic items,
- Figurine of Wondrous Power exists and is correctly bounded,
- Avatar of Death and Giant Fly are accounted for,
- class progression tables are represented or mapped,
- Dragonborn Draconic Ancestry is structured,
- creature and NPC records include complete stat-block sections,
- document-wide tables are emitted, mapped, or intentionally ignored,
- flattened prose is not used as a substitute for structured data needed for play.

Acceptance criteria

- A fresh audit bundle is attached or committed according to project convention.
- The structure audit has no unexplained findings.
- Any remaining ignored source structures have explicit rationale.
- The final report states whether the pack meets the intended acceptance bar:
  source text captured somewhere, or usable structured game data.
notes: Final audit completed at commit 4a01872. Fresh bundle: /tmp/eshyra-4a7.9-final.zip (SHA-256 fe02909dacf991d33fb8aee6c10d763d37735f2d5728ef7367bba783b90cf575). Results: 1772 records, 2258 source structures, 0 suspicious, 0 structure/coverage findings, 0 unaccounted, 0 known gaps, reproducibility clean. Final report: docs/audits/srd-5.1-final-source-completeness.md.
close_reason: Fresh bundle and final source-completeness report confirm the pack meets the acceptance bar with no unexplained findings or gaps.
